narr: Several rounds of storms with heavy rain moved across north-central Wisconsin during the early morning of July 15th. Radar estimates indicate a band of 3 to 5 inches of rain fell from northwest Clark County to the southeast part of the county. This heavy rain caused water to go over a few county roads near Chili (Clark County) and Thorp (Clark County).
ev: Runoff from heavy rains pushed some creeks out of their banks. Water from the South Branch O'Neill Creek went over County Highway Y between Chili and U.S. Highway 10. Water from the North Fork Eau Claire River went over County Highway X west of Thorp, and County Highway H northwest of Chili was covered by standing water.
